# StaticInvocationViaThis

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `StaticInvocationViaThisInspection`

Calling a static method through an object (`$this->make()` or `$obj->make()`)
hides the fact that no instance is involved. Use `self::`/`ClassName::` so the
call reads as what it is.

## Example

```php{12,22,23}
<?php
class Palette {
    public static function shade($level) { return $level; }
    public static function staticTone() { return 0; }
    public function tint() { return 1; }

    public static function fromStatic() {
        return self::shade(1);
    }

    public function render() {
        $a = $this->shade(2);
        $b = $this->tint();
        $c = $this->staticTone();
        $d = self::shade(3);
        $e = function () { return $this->shade(4); };
    }
}

function paint(Palette $given) {
    $local = new Palette();
    $x = $local->shade(5);
    $y = (new Palette())->shade(6);
    $z = $given->shade(7);
    $w = makePalette()->shade(8);
    return function () use ($local) { return $local->shade(9); };
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 12: Static method shade() called through $this; use self::shade().</li>
<li>line 22: Static method shade() called on an instance; call it with ::.</li>
<li>line 23: Static method shade() called on an instance; call it with ::.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| EXCEPT_PHPUNIT_ASSERTIONS | bool | true | Skip static methods declared in PHPUnit framework classes and Symfony's test assertion traits (E3). |
| EXCEPT_ELOQUENT_MODELS | bool | true | Skip static methods declared in Laravel's Eloquent base model (E4). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "StaticInvocationViaThis": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "EXCEPT_PHPUNIT_ASSERTIONS": true,
        "EXCEPT_ELOQUENT_MODELS": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore StaticInvocationViaThis

/**
 * @noinspection StaticInvocationViaThisInspection
 */
```
